This bean plot is small, only 0.06 hectares, but it helps feed my family. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I do not need to buy expensive chemical fertilizer like farmers do for teff or wheat. I will put some compost and manure from our animals on the plot to keep the soil fertile, and I will plant local bean seeds that I saved from last harvest. The plot is close to home, so my family can do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without hiring anyone, and we never use pesticides or irrigation on beans.
